Options:
  -c, --configuration CONFIGURATION  Select build configuration
  -f, --framework FRAMEWORK  Select target framework
  -r, --runtime RUNTIME  Select runtime identifier
  -o, --output OUTPUT  Set output directory
  --no-restore  Skip package restore
  -v, --verbosity LEVEL  Set logging detail
  --nologo  Suppress the startup banner
  --no-build  Skip compilation
  --filter EXPRESSION  Filter test cases
  --logger LOGGER  Select a test logger
  --results-directory DIRECTORY  Set results directory
  --collect COLLECTOR  Enable a data collector
  --list-tests  List discovered tests
